All quantifiers N squarefree and p least prime are explicit. A separate implementation reduced cyclotomic sums exactly and exhaustively matched 379086 candidate ordered pairs, plus 1200 N=105 samples. Numerical eigenspectrum tests supplement rather than replace the exact polynomial argument. Scientific limitation: no claim for nonleast cardinalities or nonsquarefree N.

value.rationale: The prime-cardinality spectral-pair incidence operator is a canonical global Fourier-basis compatibility invariant. Its dimension is Q^p, yet its exact rank is only 2^(omega(N)-1), and all signed eigenvalues and compatible ordered pair counts are closed products for every squarefree cyclic group with least prime cardinality. This is structural compression and complete classification of the compatibility graph across arbitrarily many prime factors, not a narrow isolated census or textbook special-case norm.
